desc_zh: 听说村东来了头妖兽，已经伤了两个猎户。他望着东边，若有所思。
desc_en: Word is a beast east of the village has hurt two hunters. He gazes eastward - thinking.
choice_prompt_zh: 东边妖兽作乱，我该去除害吗？
choice_prompt_en: A beast is rampaging east. Should I go deal with it?

desc_zh: 缠斗半日，妖兽伏诛。他一瘸一拐地回来，身后跟着一路道谢的村民。
desc_en: After half a day of battle the beast fell. He limped home trailed by grateful villagers.
chain_summary_zh: 那年他孤身赴东，除了伤人的妖兽。
chain_summary_en: That year he went east alone and slew the beast.

desc_zh: 他终究没去。后来听说猎户们自己设陷阱解决了。他心里有种说不清的滋味。
desc_en: In the end he stayed. The hunters trapped it themselves - he felt something he could not name.
chain_summary_zh: 妖兽作乱那回，他选择了闭关。
chain_summary_en: When the beast rampaged - he chose seclusion.
